subject: Matrix argument for CDE/excluding interactions between the same species

messages.author: 0a784edb642f758b
messages.subject: Matrix argument for CDE/excluding interactions between the same species
parts:
Good afternoon,

I'd like to look at the CDEs just between individuals of two species and not with individuals from the same species. Would a matrix like this one theoretically work for the exclude function in CDE? Each cell is an interaction between two individuals, where the first 5 are one species and the next 7 are another. A cell of 1 would indicate that that interaction will be excluded. 

mat <- read.csv("matrix_encounters.csv")
CDE <- encounter(akdeall, exclude=mat) 

Thank you!
